subject.title: feat: open Control UI links in a macOS sidebar browser

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor an in-app macOS sidebar browser for external Control UI HTTP(S) links, or keep sending those links to the user's default browser?
rationale: This is a new native/web product and security boundary for external content inside the macOS app, and the protected `maintainer` label means automation should not decide the direction.

options.title: Sponsor the scoped two-PR plan
options.body: Proceed with the proposed bridge first and native WKWebView sidebar second, requiring tests and macOS visual proof for both default-browser and inline paths.

options.title: Keep default-browser behavior
options.body: Decline the in-app browser direction and keep off-origin dashboard links leaving the app through `NSWorkspace`.

options.title: Request a design spike
options.body: Ask for a small prototype or security notes before committing to arbitrary external-page rendering inside the app.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the scoped two-PR plan
recommendation.body: Proceed with the proposed bridge first and native WKWebView sidebar second, requiring tests and macOS visual proof for both default-browser and inline paths.

likelyOwner.reason: He opened the request and has the clearest recent history on the native mac dashboard controller and product direction.
